nodes.text: Seff. Don't lean on her, she's drying. What?

choices.text: Why do the boats have eyes?
What wood holds against the mere?

nodes.text: A boat launched blind stays lost. Every hull off this slip gets her eyes painted last, when the rest of her is true. Old custom. Older than the town. I didn't start it and I won't be the one who stops it.
No. A hull takes a season and I build for crews I'll answer to. Come back with a crew, a season, and a name for her. Then we'll talk.
Oak keel, willow ribs. The mere argues with both. The keel wins the argument and the ribs survive it. That's boats.
Walk wide of the sawdust. It travels.
